stories.title: Duke Energy customers will see higher bills starting in January after rate increases approved

stories.title: Man found dead at east Charlotte nature preserve, homicide investigation underway

stories.title: Mecklenburg County, Discovery place deal to open Freedom Park nature museum

stories.title: City of Charlotte settles unlawful force suit stemming from June 2020 protests for $1.7M
stories.summary: Plaintiffs argued that once police "kettled" protesters in, officers deployed force, including tear gas and stinger grenades, despite no immediate threat.

stories.title: Mooresville school to remain closed for mold cleanup, district says
